column1: # Mapping: Google language-resources bn-BD lexicon notation -> BanglaPhonologyBench IPA
# Conventions on our side (match bangla_phonology.py gold set):
#   - dental stops carry the bridge diacritic (t̪, d̪); retroflex are ʈ, ɖ
#   - the palatal stop series c/ch/j/jh is rendered as affricates tʃ/dʒ (standard
#     for Bangla; Google's IPA column uses c/ɟ)
#   - voiced aspirates use ʱ, voiceless use ʰ
#   - glide symbols (X^) are offglides/onglides; ingestion MERGES them with the
#     adjacent vowel into one diphthong phoneme (e i^ -> ei̯), since diphthongs
#   - '.' is the lexicon's syllable separator, not a phoneme
#   - NOTE: the lexicon does NOT transcribe vowel nasalization (bn-BD colloquial
#     policy, see transcription.md): চাঁদ -> c a d. Nasalization is recoverable
#     from orthography (candrabindu) if needed; our aligner does not count ঁ as
#     a consonant, so alignment is unaffected.
#   - the lexicon has no ph symbol: ফ is transcribed f throughout.
